end.summary: Ananya practised physical and chemical changes.
end.parentNote: Asha used melting ice, ghee, burnt roti, and curd to practise the rule: a physical change makes no new substance and may change shape, size, or state. Ananya correctly identified melting ice and ghee as physical changes and burnt roti and curd formation as chemical changes. The mix-up between reversibility and the type of change was clarified later using the “new substance” test, though the final teach-back was not fully passed. At home, ask Ananya to sort five everyday examples into physical or chemical changes and explain whether a new substance forms.
